_about: Tate's curated list of fun classes (2026-10-08) for the Planner's 'Something fun' row, shown only when a student's report has no open requirements. The app shows ONLY the ones with real sections this term, with their real seats and real PolyRatings; it never invents a section. Every code, title and unit count below was checked against the 2026-28 catalog (catalog.calpoly.edu/courses/<subj>/) on 2026-10-08. 'needs' quotes the catalog's own requisite; the app shows it and never calls such a class open to everyone.
